obligations.name: reacted_channels
obligations.description: Conversations that contain at least one message on which the acting user (agent1) left a reaction with emoji name 'eyes'; selection must follow conversation→message→reaction bindings on the same records.
obligations.scope: channels the acting user is a member of, discoverable via users.conversations/conversations.history and reactions.get

task_spec.text: List the channels that contain a message I reacted to with an eyes emoji.

access_plan: Discover the acting user's conversations via users.conversations (or conversations.list filtered to memberships), pull each channel's messages with conversations.history, and check reactions per message via reactions.get to find those where the reactor is the acting user and the emoji name is 'eyes'; the matching messages' channel_id fields identify the answer conversations.
